about: Full stick at a 0.6 m column 10.5 m ahead (factory scene, SITL x500, planar lidar 12 m, external navigation, 2 m/s horizontal cap), until the brake had stopped the vehicle. One frame per scan: the attitude, AGL, estimated position and velocity of that moment, the simulator's true velocity (truth_vel_ne) and the stick's ask (ask_ne). Times in ms from the first frame.
